items.title: How Flickr modernized caching with Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey
items.summary: Flickr, part of SmugMug, serves over 100 million photographers. In this post, the Flickr team shares how they modernized their caching layer by migrating from Redis and Twemproxy to Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey, consolidating more than 40 clusters, enabling cluster mode and multi-AZ failover, and moving to PhpRedis, all with no end-user disruption.
items.creator: Wilson Lam

items.title: Multi-tenancy with Amazon ElastiCache: Choosing the right isolation model
items.summary: Choosing a multi-tenancy isolation model for Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey comes up in nearly every SaaS architecture review. This post walks through the options, from dedicated clusters to shared infrastructure with per-tenant encryption, and shows how to match each model to your blast radius and compliance requirements.
items.creator: Maria Gutovsky
